expectations.text: All method parameters use the 'final' keyword
expectations.evidence: createRequestFactory(final ClientProperties properties), processPayment(final PaymentRequest request), getPayment(final String paymentId) - all use final

expectations.text: Each RestClient bean has an explicit name via @Bean(name = "...") or @Bean("...")
Configuration properties are defined as Java records with @ConfigurationProperties
expectations.evidence: PaymentsClientProperties and NotificationsClientProperties are records with @ConfigurationProperties and @DefaultValue

expectations.text: Both RestClient beans have connect and read timeouts configured
expectations.evidence: createRequestFactory sets connectTimeout and readTimeout via SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory

expectations.text: Service class uses @Qualifier to inject the correct named RestClient bean
expectations.evidence: @Qualifier("paymentsRestClient") on the RestClient field in PaymentIntegrationService

expectations.text: No hardcoded URLs in the code — all URLs come from ConfigurationProperties
expectations.evidence: baseUrl comes from paymentsProperties.baseUrl() and notificationsProperties.baseUrl(), with @DefaultValue defaults in properties records
